I enjoyed the subject matter of computer science, but felt many of the professors I was working with weren't really concerned with the success of their students. Additionally the program wasn't very hands on; we would have classroom lectures, then assignments, with very little practical demonstration of code. Have I made a misstep?
Computer Science Vs. Software Development, which will better prepare me?
